name: Automatic Variation
definition: Predefined variations that may be attributable to an undertaking such as a guarantee or standby letter of credit.

VariationAmount.name: Variation Amount
VariationAmount.definition: Variation specified as a monetary amount increase or decrease to the undertaking amount.

Undertaking.name: Undertaking
Undertaking.definition: Undertaking for which a predefined variation is specified.

Trigger.name: Trigger
Trigger.definition: Trigger that causes the variation to come into effect.
